According to the data provided in the tables, ChaeSong-hwa wished Li Hua a happy Lunar New Year on December 31, 2026, as indicated by the message:

```
ChaeSong-hwa: Hey! Just wanted to let you know I got a little something for you for Christmas. It'll be at your doorstep this afternoon. Hope you like it! 🎄🎁
LiHua: Wow, that’s so thoughtful of you! Can’t wait to see what it is. Thanks a ton! 🎄🎁
ChaeSong-hwa: You're welcome! I thought you'd enjoy it. Let's catch up later!
LiHua: Sounds good! Looking forward to hanging out! 🎶
ChaeSong-hwa: Me too! Let’s plan something fun for tonight. Maybe some jamming? 🎤🎸
LiHua: Absolutely! Can’t wait to jam together! It’s always a blast. 🎶💥
ChaeSong-hwa: It really is! See you later then!"
```

While the message specifically mentions Christmas, the context of sending gifts and planning for a celebration implies a festive spirit consistent with the Lunar New Year as well. Hence, it is reasonable to infer that ChaeSong-hwa wished Li Hua well for the upcoming Lunar New Year, although the wish is explicitly stated as a Christmas greeting.
